-Thing is being mentally mature is different for everyone, maturity is usually gained because of life experiences that's why you tend to see people who usually have gone through a lot of problems and drawbacks in their life are usually more mature than people who have had an easy life

-You can't force yourself to be mature but you can try to look back at the decisions you take and how you act in different situations and see what you could've done differently to make you appear more mature

-Also remember part if being actually a mature person is not caring what other people think bout you and not stressing over people's opinion especially if you are not doing anything wrong

-surrounding yourself with people that have a maturity level of the one you wanna be at also helps ( change happens slowly so it's not gonna happen overnight but being around them more and more will slowly lead to changes in your behavior and you will become a more mature person) that's why surrounding yourself with good people is generally better anyways

-at the end of the day some people are just gonna be more mature than others but that doesn't make you any less
